messages.subject: Rationale behind convert2riself genotype conversion
parts:
Hi Karl,

I am working with a RIL population and was considering using the convert2riself function on my cross. I think I can understand why the AB calls would be omitted when BB > AB, but what is the rationale behind converting AB calls to BB when BB < AB? Thank you for the clarification.

Nathaniel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Rationale behind convert2riself genotype conversion
parts:
Just trying to guess at which are the correct genotype labels.

Most commonly, the data initially get treated as a backcross, with AA/AB genotypes, so in converting to RIL, we flip AB -> BB.

karl
